fields.summary: TC-853-01: Save and Replace Repo Processes Involuntary Trip Change and Updates COA Record

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-853

Precondition: The Save and Replace repo has been created and deployed with Veracode scan completed (RITM12915170). A valid involuntary Save and Replace event is available. COA_CSS_TOGGLE=TRUE, COA_CSS_PHASE_2_TOGGLE=TRUE.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Perform an involuntary Save and Replace via CSS for an existing trip assignment
Involuntary Save and Replace: existing trip V0 replaced with V1, changeType=INVOL, crew member reassigned to new legs
Save and Replace transaction is executed successfully in CSS and downstream events are triggered
Verify the Save and Replace repo captures the transaction and processes the CSS outbox events
CSS outbox table and Save and Replace repo processing logs
Save and Replace repo reads the CSS outbox events and initiates COA processing for the new trip version
Verify Kafka events are published for the Save and Replace - pairing and assignment topics updated
Kafka topics: ent.workforce.crewPairing.v2.techp and ent.workforce.crewAssignment.v2
Pairing and assignment Kafka events reflect the Save and Replace with updated trip V1 data
Verify the COA Step Function processes the aggregated event from the Save and Replace and updates DynamoDB
COA Step Function execution and DynamoDB coatable record after processing
DynamoDB COA record is updated with V1 trip data, new legs, updated isOriginal flags, and correct LCO codes
Verify the COA Search App reflects the updated trip after Save and Replace processing
COA Search App queried for the trip after Save and Replace
COA Search App displays V1 trip data with correct legs, isOriginal flags, and LCO codes from the Save and Replace
